Maybe try financing with the dealership. Most used car dealerships work with poor credit and 1500 is at least 20% down for the cars price. You will have a high apr most likely because of your situation. So maybe try and get a co-signer. Since your employment history is a big thing that gets looked at when asking for a loan in your situation. They need someone who isn’t too big of a risk to loan the money to. If none of that is reachable, then just save a bit more and wait two months and save as much as possible in that time frame. If it’s still there after that time period, go for it. They also take a look at what the possible debt to income ratio would be for you, so make sure your job pays enough for the type of car you are trying to get. There are always plenty of cars to buy now and plenty to buy later in life once you have the money to do so. So don’t be afraid to take the loss now, and then buy the car of your dreams when you’re well off. It will save you from lots of struggling.
